title: Simple Tree Capitator
description: A lightweight Fabric mod that lets players toggle tree capitating and cut down connected logs with an axe.
body:
# Simple Tree Capitator

**Simple Tree Capitator** is a lightweight Fabric mod that makes cutting down trees faster and easier.

When enabled, breaking one log with an axe will automatically break the connected logs in the tree. It also includes fast leaf decay, so leaves disappear quickly after the tree is cut while still allowing natural drops like saplings, sticks, and apples.

## Features

* Toggle tree capitating on and off with the **B** key
* Break one log with an axe to cut connected tree logs
* Requires an axe to activate
* Supports vanilla logs and stems using Minecraft log tags
* Works with normal trees, large trees, jungle branches, and nether stems
* Fast leaf decay after cutting a tree
* Natural leaves can still drop saplings, sticks, and apples
* Player-placed persistent leaves are protected
* Includes safety limits to help prevent lag
* Works in singleplayer
* Works on multiplayer servers when installed on both client and server

## How to use

1. Install **Fabric Loader**
2. Install **Fabric API**
3. Put **Simple Tree Capitator** in your `mods` folder
4. Launch Minecraft
5. Press **B** to turn Tree Capitator on or off
6. Break a log with an axe
7. Connected logs will be cut automatically

## Supported blocks

Simple Tree Capitator uses Minecraft log tags, so it supports vanilla log and stem types such as:

* Oak
* Spruce
* Birch
* Jungle
* Acacia
* Dark Oak
* Mangrove
* Cherry
* Pale Oak
* Crimson Stem
* Warped Stem

## Multiplayer

For multiplayer servers, this mod should be installed on **both the client and the server**.

The client handles the toggle keybind, and the server handles the tree cutting logic.

## Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Minecraft 26.1.x
* Java 25

## Future plans

Possible future updates may include:

* Configurable max tree size
* Configurable leaf decay radius
* Toggleable leaf decay
* Custom keybind options
* Modded tree support improvements
* Config file support
